title: Tool and app distinction encoded as single bit on ToolPresentation.isApp
context: The shell mounts both first-party apps and third-party tools in the same tool window with identical UI treatment.
decision: Store whether a presentation is an app or tool as one `isApp` boolean field, not separate types. Apps invoke in-process to app_call; tools invoke over a broker to their core process.
consequences: Apps and tools receive no special tab, badge, or separate section in the bar—the implementation-detail difference is invisible to users. Simplifies routing logic.
